answer: Keeping 45 aliases alive thus means 45 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the raven quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the lagoon log exposes the live set and the wharf audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 647 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 28 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
